Not measured yet, because each needs a rendered original or a browser:

  • A2-A5: needs structure, class, computed-style and pixel match against the original's golden render (no render of the site examples or preview cards yet)
  • B2: needs the page frame equals the nearest original's frame (needs the golden render)
  • B4-B6: needs every component node carries its pinned recipe and every other node is a layout or text element
  • B7: needs regions below the header, stat cards and primary tables counted from the rendered DOM
  • B8: needs frame pixel difference against the golden render
  • B9: needs each chart's family, series, tooltip and legend read from the rendered page
  • X6-X10: needs computed colours, fonts, accessibility findings and horizontal overflow in a browser
  • C: needs the form-specific check of each Tier C form (the marked region and its geometry)

Mapped: the page has a block. Specified: it has a redesign spec. Implemented: it has been rebuilt to the spec. Verified: someone walked it beside the reference. Each stage counts the pages that have reached it or gone further.
